## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- EntitlementOverrideStore (U-COMM-05)
- isDenied is true ONLY for an explicit false override
- persists across instances and lists all
- removeOverride reverts to plan-decides and drops empty user entries
- throws on missing userId/feature; never on absent reads
- fails loud on a corrupt store (no reset-then-clobber)
